sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that defeat, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and they'll be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have won just once all season and arrive in poor form.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday—a winnable fixture for the promotion chasers, though Stafford themselves suffered a recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth visit mid-table Eccleshall in what could be a close encounter between sides separated by just one point. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in good recent form, entertain Wednesfield Community at home, then face Sandbach away midweek in a key fixture. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in an all-mid-table clash with both sides in reasonable form. Bottom-dweller Widnes Town visit Brereton Social, who have endured a difficult run; New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a basement battle; Shawbury United continue their dreadful losing streak at home to improving Barnton; Crewe face Allscott Heath; and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a match between two of the division's weakest-performing sides.
